headline: Legendary coach, Hall of Fame TE Mike Ditka dies at age 86
summary: Mike Ditka, a Hall of Fame tight end who became an NFL legend for his time as coach of the Bears, has died at the age of 86.

headline: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson out; Huntley to start SNF vs. Falcons
summary: The Ravens are ruling out quarterback Lamar Jackson for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

headline: Commanders QB Daniels will play, WR Diggs out against Giants
summary: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels will start Sunday in his return from an elbow injury, but wide receiver Stefon Diggs will not play against the Giants due to a hamstring injury.

headline: Mason Graham, Mike Hall will not play for Browns on Sunday
summary: The Browns will be thin in the center of their defensive line for Sunday's game against the Jets.

headline: Patriots won't have starting CBs Christian Gonzalez, Carlton Davis
summary: The Patriots will be without starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez and Carlton Davis this week.

headline: Jets rule out Breece Hall, Adonai Mitchell
summary: The Jets will remain shorthanded on offense for Sunday's game against the Browns.
